---
name: alembic
description: Use when database schema changes require an Alembic migration — after adding, removing, or modifying SQLAlchemy models. Enforces autogenerated migrations only, never hand-written ones.
---

# Alembic migrations

**NEVER create or modify migration files by hand.** Migrations are always autogenerated
from the SQLAlchemy models:

```bash
uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m "<message>"
```

The command often needs to run from within the current docker-compose app container
(the database must be reachable), e.g.:

```bash
docker compose exec app uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m "<message>"
```

Workflow: change the models first, then autogenerate the migration and review the
generated file for correctness — but fix issues by adjusting the models and
regenerating, not by editing the migration.
